record.bible_text: Then came<WH0935><WTH8799> David<WH01732> to Nob<WH05011> to Ahimelech<WH0288> the priest<WH03548>: and Ahimelech<WH0288> was afraid<WH02729><WTH8799> at the meeting<WH07125><WTH8800> of David<WH01732>, and said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto him, Why <FI>art<Fi>  thou alone, and no man<WH0376> with thee? <RF>Ahimelech: also called Ahiah<Rf>

And David<WH01732> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto Ahimelech<WH0288> the priest<WH03548>, The king<WH0428> hath commanded<WH06680><WTH8765> me a business<WH01697>, and hath said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto me, Let no man<WH0376> know<WH03045><WTH8799> any thing<WH03972> of the business<WH01697> whereabout I send<WH07971><WTH8802> thee, and what I have commanded<WH06680><WTH8765> thee: and I have appointed<WH03045><WTH8776> <FI>my<Fi> servants<WH05288> to such<WH06423> and such<WH0492> a place<WH04725>.

Now therefore what is<WH03426> under thine hand<WH03027>? give<WH05414><WTH8798> <FI>me<Fi> five<WH02568> <FI>loaves of<Fi> bread<WH03899> in mine hand<WH03027>, or what there is present<WH04672><WTH8737>. <RF>present: Heb. found<Rf>

And the priest<WH03548> answered<WH06030><WTH8799> David<WH01732>, and said<WH0559><WTH8799>, <FI>There is<Fi> no common<WH02455> bread<WH03899> under mine hand<WH03027>, but there is<WH03426> hallowed<WH06944> bread<WH03899>; if the young men<WH05288> have kept<WH08104><WTH8738> themselves at least<WH0389> from women<WH0802>.

And David<WH01732> answered<WH06030><WTH8799> the priest<WH03548>, and said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto him, Of a truth<WH0518> women<WH0802> <FI>have been<Fi> kept<WH06113><WTH8803> from us about these three<WH08032> days<WH08543>, since I came out<WH03318><WTH8800>, and the vessels<WH03627> of the young men<WH05288> are holy<WH06944>, and <FI>the bread is<Fi> in a manner<WH01870> common<WH02455>, yea, though it were sanctified<WH06942><WTH8799> this day<WH03117> in the vessel<WH03627>. <RF>yea...: or, especially when this day there is other sanctified in the vessel<Rf>

So the priest<WH03548> gave<WH05414><WTH8799> him hallowed<WH06944> <FI>bread<Fi> : for there was no bread<WH03899> there but the shewbread<WH03899><WH06440>, that was taken<WH05493><WTH8716> from before<WH06440> the LORD<WH03068>, to put<WH07760><WTH8800> hot<WH02527> bread<WH03899> in the day<WH03117> when it was taken away<WH03947><WTH8736>.

Now a certain man<WH0376> of the servants<WH05650> of Saul<WH07586> <FI>was<Fi> there that day<WH03117>, detained<WH06113><WTH8737> before<WH06440> the LORD<WH03068>; and his name<WH08034> <FI>was<Fi>  Doeg<WH01673>, an Edomite<WH0130>, the chiefest<WH047> of the herdmen<WH07462><WTH8802> that <FI>belonged<Fi> to Saul<WH07586>.

And David<WH01732> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto Ahimelech<WH0288>, And is there<WH03426> not<WH0371> here under thine hand<WH03027> spear<WH02595> or sword<WH02719>? for I have neither brought<WH03947><WTH8804> my sword<WH02719> nor my weapons<WH03627> with me<WH03027>, because the king's<WH04428> business<WH01697> required<WH01961><WTH8804> haste<WH05169><WTH8803>.

And the priest<WH03548> said<WH0559><WTH8799>, The sword<WH02719> of Goliath<WH01555> the Philistine<WH06430>, whom thou slewest<WH05221><WTH8689> in the valley<WH06010> of Elah<WH0425>, behold, it <FI>is here<Fi> wrapped<WH03874><WTH8803> in a cloth<WH08071> behind<WH0310> the ephod<WH0646>: if thou wilt take<WH03947><WTH8799> that, take<WH03947><WTH8798> <FI>it<Fi> : for <FI>there is<Fi> no other<WH0312> save<WH02108> that here<WH02088>. And David<WH01732> said<WH0559><WTH8799>, <FI>There is<Fi> none like that; give<WH05414><WTH8798> it me.<CM>

And David<WH01732> arose<WH06965><WTH8799>, and fled<WH01272><WTH8799> that day<WH03117> for fear<WH06440> of Saul<WH07586>, and went<WH0935><WTH8799> to Achish<WH0397> the king<WH04428> of Gath<WH01661>.

And the servants<WH05650> of Achish<WH0397> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto him, <FI>Is<Fi> not this David<WH01732> the king<WH04428> of the land<WH0776>? did they not sing<WH06030><WTH8799> one to another of him<WH02088> in dances<WH04246>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, Saul<WH07586> hath slain<WH05221><WTH8689> his thousands<WH0505>, and David<WH01732> his ten thousands<WH07233>?
And David<WH01732> laid up<WH07760><WTH8799> these words<WH01697> in his heart<WH03824>, and was sore<WH03966> afraid<WH03372><WTH8799> of<WH06440> Achish<WH0397> the king<WH04428> of Gath<WH01661>.

And he changed<WH08138><WTH8762> his behaviour<WH02940> before<WH05869> them, and feigned himself mad<WH01984><WTH8704> in their hands<WH03027>, and scrabbled<WH08427><WTH8762> on the doors<WH01817> of the gate<WH08179>, and let his spittle<WH07388> fall down<WH03381><WTH8686> upon his beard<WH02206>. <RF>scrabbled: or, made marks<Rf>

Then said<WH0559><WTH8799> Achish<WH0397> unto his servants<WH05650>, Lo, ye see<WH07200><WTH8799> the man<WH0376> is mad<WH07696><WTH8693>: wherefore <FI>then<Fi> have ye brought<WH0935><WTH8686> him to me? <RF>is mad: or, playeth the mad man<Rf>

Have I need<WH02638> of mad men<WH07696><WTH8794>, that ye have brought<WH0935><WTH8689> this <FI>fellow<Fi> to play the mad man<WH07696><WTH8692> in my presence? shall this <FI>fellow<Fi> come<WH0935><WTH8799> into my house<WH01004>?<CM>
